purpose: Define the next allowed default-off graph/dataflow probe after the sparse top64 up/down pair profile. This is a plan/design artifact only, not a SOTA result.

cpu_backend_fused_best.reason: Even after removing up-output D2H and down-input H2D, CPU-backend fused skip/write remains below 10 tok/s before further integration overhead.

required_assumptions: up/down hot pair kernels run at measured MMVQ speed
current gate cache impact already accounts for the 544 MiB up/down payload

gate_recompute.reason: Recomputing gate consumes the only margin and worsens gate-cache pressure.

existing_ds4_hot_manager.reason: Per-layer dummy slots inflate payload far beyond the 18.947 ms graph-bound margin.

current_blocker.description: The accepted gate stream is a CPU-backend helper. It computes chunks on GPU but copies gate output back to CPU dst and scatters on CPU, so it does not currently provide a reusable graph-level gate GPU tensor.
current_blocker.evidence: Current one_trace.csv includes d2h_ms/scatter_ms fields for gate stream rows; source code path writes CPU dst after CUDA work.
current_blocker.impact: The 10.014 tok/s graph zero-transfer result is not an implementable runtime path until a probe proves gate output or an equivalent hidden tensor can stay on GPU through sparse up/down.

must_prove_before_performance_run: only selected top64 sparse up/down pairs are resident or staged as declared
payload is 544 MiB plus documented minimal metadata/workspace, with no per-layer dummy slots
no hidden CPU-backend H2D/D2H between gate/up/down
gate output is a real GPU tensor or an equivalent retained GPU buffer
16GB cgroup includes file page cache and swap remains disabled
reject_immediately_if: uses existing per-layer dummy slot hot manager payload shape
uses CPU-backend D2H/H2D round trips in the hot branch
cannot prove gate GPU reuse or equivalent retained hidden activation
changes logits before fixed-text top1 correctness passes

before_logit_write: France prompt output is semantically correct and coherent
op-level compare/tolerance documented if MMVQ output replaces CPU fallback
no OOM, no swap, memory.max=16000000000 including page cache
before_sota_promotion: TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms for an accepted result
strict cold drop_caches run inside 16GB cgroup including page cache
source plus artifacts committed and pushed to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb
clean pushed-source reproduction passes the same metrics

next_required_artifact_if_probe_passes: A separate hard-bound artifact with expected decode saving, kernel time, launch/sync overhead, remaining transfers, VRAM/RAM including page cache, TTFT impact, rollback rule, exact env/command, and correctness evidence.
